propositions: recheck-review currently refuses any current-revision finding state, but should accept bugfix-size-attestation blocks when the ticket carries a valid plan-review attestation

a recheck-review acceptance for bugfix-size-attestation must verify the block contains exactly one finding, parse the criterion from the bot's vote message header (not truncated detail), and resolve the ticket id from commit-message trailer

the acceptance decision must reuse the gate's own classifier and bucket logic (classify_plan_review_attestation / bucket_for_verdict) to avoid drift, and refuse on any infra verdict or non-accepted bucket

the label-copy condition (NO_CODE_CHANGE / TRIVIAL_REBASE) incorrectly copies bugfix-size-attestation findings across patchsets because attestation state lives on the ticket, not the diff, and cannot change without code changes

parse failures and missing evidence (unparseable count, missing criterion line, unresolvable ticket id, classifier exception, forged comment data) must all refuse fail-closed, never assume the precondition
